category: webhard content marketplace (Korean: subscription download of a domestic catalogue)

free_tier.stated: No free download allowance on the charge page; the entry product is a 30-day pass: '30일 무제한 이용권 - 정기결제(자동결제) 50% 20,000원 9,900원 - 1개월 45% 20,000원 11,000원'. A second tier: 25,000원 list at 13,200원 recurring / 14,500원 one month; a third: 30,000원 list at 15,600원 / 17,000원.
free_tier.notes: The unit is a 30-day window of unlimited catalogue downloads, not bytes. Sign-up is marketed as ten seconds ('회원가입은 10초면 충분합니다').

per_object_cap.stated: no per-file cap published; the pass covers '파일캐스트(제휴콘텐츠 제외)의 모든 콘텐츠'

retention.stated: not applicable: a catalogue, not client storage

egress.terms: Unlimited downloads inside the 30-day window of the domestic catalogue; the pass excludes partner content ('제휴콘텐츠 제외'). Fair-use clause: '일반적인 이용이 아닌 다른 용도로 사용할 경우 다운로드가 제한될 수 있습니다'.

interface_detail: Web plus a Windows download client (the site advertises speed through its own client) and a mobile app. No API.
tooling: The vendor's own PC client and mobile app; the catalogue is not exposed to rclone or JDownloader.
chaining: Not a multi-hoster and not chainable into one: it retrieves only Filecast's own catalogue, so it solves Korean-content gaps rather than host gaps. For a user's stack it is a source of Korean media, never of arbitrary URLs.

limits.value: unstated; unlimited within the 30-day pass subject to the fair-use clause
paid tier only exists as a domestic subscription; no per-file sale on this page

limits_note: Two contradictory VAT statements sit on the same page: '결제시 부가세 10%가 포함됩니다' beside the price table and '모든 이용권 금액은 부가세 10% 별도 입니다' in the notes. The conservative reading (VAT extra) is the one recorded.
binding_note: There is no byte meter to hit

identity_cost.detail: The product is a Korean domestic 정액제: the charge flow is the vendor's own '캐스트 원페이' and the refund clause speaks to a mobile number ('환불로 인한 휴대폰 정보는 ...'), which places a Korean handset in the payment path. No card rail for foreign issuers is documented on the page.

reliability_note: Subscriptions are Korean-time based ('월정액 상품의 사용기간은 대한민국 표준시간을 기준으로 합니다'), refunds only within 48 hours and only once, and downloads are throttled for non-ordinary use under the fair-use clause.
confidence_note: Charge page read with prices and clauses. The identity claim rests on the domestic payment flow plus the mobile-number clause; completing a signup from outside Korea would test it, and that test is the thing this record says will fail.

evidence.proved: terms: '결제시 부가세 10%가 포함됩니다' and '모든 이용권 금액은 부가세 10% 별도 입니다'; '월정액 상품의 사용기간은 대한민국 표준시간을 기준으로 합니다'; '결제 후 48시간 이내에 신청하셔야만 환불이 가능합니다'

price_per_tb_month: KRW 9,900 per 30 days (recurring) or KRW 11,000 one month, plus 10% VAT by the conservative reading
notes: Korea's retrieval market is not debrid at all: it is webhard, a domestic catalogue sold by the month. That is why the Korean queries return no premium-link generator.

extras.client: vendor PC client plus mobile app
